name: UK weather warnings
summary: Met Office yellow snow warning for 17 Nov covers southern Scotland, northern England, Yorkshire and the Midlands
state: At 11:41 UTC on 16 Nov the Met Office had a yellow snow warning for 17 Nov across seven regions: Dumfries, Galloway, Lothian and Borders, Strathclyde, North East and North West England, Yorkshire and Humber, and the East and West Midlands; the earlier ice warnings had lapsed and no amber or red warning was issued (Met Office). A yellow warning across this many regions counts as widespread, so Watch is kept.
for_you: Check the Met Office warnings page and National Highways or Traffic Scotland before travelling on 17 Nov; snow may disrupt roads and rail in the warned areas.
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events
why: Met Office warnings are the official signal for disruption to travel, power and safety in the UK.
drivers: Storms, heavy rain, snow and ice, heat, fog, thunderstorms.

rubric.watch: Widespread yellow or any amber warning in force.
rubric.normal: No warnings, or only localised yellow warnings.
